title: Evaluating Generalization Capabilities of LLM-Based Agents in Mixed-Motive Scenarios Using Concordia
benchmark_measurement: This benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on evaluating the generalization capabilities of LLM-based agents in mixed-motive social scenarios, specifically their ability to cooperate, negotiate, and achieve mutual gains.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
references: Marwa Abdulhai, Gregory Serapio-Garcia, Clément Crepy, Daria Valter, John Canny, and Natasha Jaques. Moral foundations of large language models, 2023.
